title.zh: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额
title.en: Federated Hermes计划于明年年初首次发行代币化基金份额

current_state.zh: 管理着9110亿美元资产的Federated Hermes表示，将于明年初与数字证券基础设施提供商Prometheum合作，首次发行代币化基金份额，货币市场基金可能成为首批产品之一。
current_state.en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, said it will issue tokenized fund shares for the first time early next year in partnership with digital securities infrastructure provider Prometheum, with money market funds possibly among the first products.

updates.title_zh: 【Federated Hermes 计划明年初发行首批代币化基金份额】
updates.title_en: 【Federated Hermes 计划明年初发行首批代币化基金份额】
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：Federated Hermes 将自行发行首批代币化基金份额（此前由第三方平台发行），目标2027年初；与 Prometheum 合作，由其 SEC 注册经纪交易商子公司提供托管、清算和结算，并通过传统券商及财务顾问分销；具体基金和区块链尚未披露，货币市场基金可能是首选。
updates.what_changed_en: New details: Federated Hermes will self-issue its first tokenized fund shares (previously issued via third-party platforms), targeting early 2027; with Prometheum, whose SEC-registered broker-dealer subsidiary will provide custody, clearing, and settlement, and distribution via traditional brokerages and financial advisors; specific fund and blockchain not yet disclosed, money market fund likely first.
updates.current_state_zh: Federated Hermes 计划于2027年初自行发行首批代币化基金份额，与 Prometheum 合作，由其 SEC 注册经纪交易商子公司提供托管、清算和结算，并通过传统券商及财务顾问渠道分销；具体基金和区块链尚未披露，货币市场基金可能是首选。
updates.current_state_en: Federated Hermes plans to self-issue its first tokenized fund shares in early 2027 in partnership with Prometheum, whose SEC-registered broker-dealer subsidiary will provide custody, clearing, and settlement, with distribution through traditional brokerages and financial advisors; the specific fund and blockchain have not been disclosed, and a money market fund is likely first.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, plans to self-issue its first tokenized fund shares in early 2027 in partnership with Prometheum, distributing through traditional brokerages and financial advisors and likely starting with a money market fund.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Federated Hermes, a $911 billion asset manager, plans to self-issue its first tokenized fund shares in early 2027 in partnership with Prometheum, distributing through traditional brokerages and financial advisors and likely starting with a money market fund.
